Nokia's SEC record shows eight 6-K filings between July 10 and September 8, 2026, and its 7,471 granted US patents include recent work on AI/ML handover functionality and energy saving in telecom systems.

The eight 6-K filings in two months indicate frequent reporting to the SEC, but the data does not summarize their contents, so they cannot be linked to AI compute or power. The patent record is more specific: recent grants cover AI/ML model functionality in handover scenarios and energy saving in telecommunication systems. That places Nokia's AI work in network operations and efficiency, not in data center construction or grid-scale power.

The data does not include products, revenue, capital expenditure, or power capacity. Nokia's industry classification is radio and TV broadcasting and communications equipment, so the available facts do not establish a direct role in AI compute scaling.

profile_text.body:
Nokia is a Finnish telecommunications and information technology company headquartered in Espoo, founded as a pulp mill in 1865. It is listed on Nasdaq Helsinki and the New York Stock Exchange, and in 2020 employed about 92,000 people with revenue of around 23 billion euros.

Source: Wikipedia, Nokia, retrieved 22 September 2026.
